# Virello AI

> Your AI growth manager for social media.

Virello AI is an AI-powered social media growth platform. Paste a post, choose a goal, set an optional budget, and the AI analyses the content, matches it with genuinely interested audiences, and manages organic growth and paid boosts. Growth comes from real people — never bots, never fake engagement.

## Facts

- Website: https://virelloai.online
- Founded: 10 January 2026
- Based in: Multan, Punjab, Pakistan
- Contact: support@virelloai.online
- Plans: Free $0 forever; Pro $19/month ($15/month billed yearly); Business $49/month ($39/month billed yearly)
- App: Android, available on Huawei AppGallery, APKPure and Uptodown; Google Play version coming soon
- Social: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and Facebook as @virelloai.online

- [How It Works](https://virelloai.online/how.html): Four steps — paste your post, choose your goal, set an optional budget, let AI grow — and what happens in the first 24 hours.
- [Pricing](https://virelloai.online/pricing.html): Free $0 forever (3 campaigns, organic growth up to 1,000 impressions); Pro $19/month (25 campaigns, Paid Boost); Business $49/month (100 campaigns, team seats, priority support).
- [Blog](https://virelloai.online/blog.html): Honest guides for creators — TikTok, Instagram Reels, hooks, analytics, repurposing, and spotting growth-service scams.
- [Shop](https://virelloai.online/shop.html): Trending products, honestly curated, with Amazon links.
- [Free Caption Generator](https://virelloai.online/free-caption-generator.html): Free AI caption and hashtag generator — no sign-up.
- [Score Your Post](https://virelloai.online/score.html): Free AI score for any post — hook, clarity and audience fit.
- [Help Center](https://virelloai.online/help.html): Guides and answers — how growth works, plans, budgets, safety, and refunds.
- [Trust & Safety](https://virelloai.online/trust.html): How Virello keeps growth legitimate and accounts safe.
- [Contact](https://virelloai.online/contact.html): Questions about growth, billing, partnerships or press.
- [Privacy Policy](https://virelloai.online/privacy.html): What data Virello collects, how it is used, and your rights.

## What Virello does not do

- No bots, no fake followers, no fake views, no fake engagement.
- No guaranteed follower counts, rankings, or viral results.
- Never asks for your social media password; accounts connect through official sign-in only.
